object.revised_memory: A375 first-line labels: active for ASC-J9 (68) and PKI-179 (513); inactive for 161, 48, 526, 279, 386. Active compounds show SQSTM1 up and KIF20A/STMN1/CDK1/CCNA2 down, consistent with stress/autophagy and cell-cycle arrest signatures, not viability. Candidate probabilities are uniformly low for inactive compounds and high for active ones, suggesting shared systematic response may dominate over lineage-specific target dependence. Chose YAPC mostly for lowest empirical probability; this tests whether low-probability lines yield discordant labels. No causal or viability claims.
